## Packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(betareg)
library(maps)
library(sf)

```

## Import CHNA Data

```{r, chna-data}

data <- read_csv("Data/chnaclean.csv")

```
## Priorities

```{r, health-priorities}

priority_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "")

```

## Topic Colors

```{r}

topic_colors <- c(
  "Behavioral and Mental Health" = "#4E79A7",
  "Access to Care and Healthcare Equity" = "#F28E2B",
  "Chronic Disease Management" = "#E15759",
  "Social Determinants of Health" = "#76B7B2",
  "Healthy Behaviors and Wellness" = "#59A14F",
  "Community Safety" = "#EDC948",
  "Maternal and Child Health" = "#B07AA1",
  "Environmental Health" = "#FF9DA7",
  "Injury Prevention and Safety" = "#9C755F",
  "Healthcare Capacity" = "#BAB0AC"
)

```

## Unique Counties

```{r, unique-counties}

county_priority <- priority_long %>%
   distinct(County, Priority, Topic) %>%
  count(Priority, Topic, name = "Counties")

```


## Unique Hospitals

```{r}

hospital_priority <- priority_long %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, County, Priority, Topic) %>%
  count(Priority, Topic, name = "Hospitals")

```

## CHNA Priority Plot

```{r, chna-priority-plot}

make_priority_plot <- function(priority_number) {

 data <- county_priority %>%
    filter(Priority == paste0("Priority ", priority_number)) %>%
    arrange(Counties)
  
  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = Counties,
      y = reorder(Topic, Counties),
      fill = Topic
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Counties),
      hjust = -0.2,
      size = 2
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = topic_colors) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 35),
  breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste("Priority", priority_number),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      
      # Remove repeated axis titles
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      
      # Remove legend from individual plots
      legend.position = "none",
      
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

```

## Grid

```{r}

x_label <- wrap_elements(
  full = textGrob(
    "Number of Counties",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)
  )
)

y_label <- wrap_elements(
  full = textGrob(
    "Health Topic",
    rot = 90,
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)
  )
)

```

## Final CHNA Column Plot

```{r, final-chna-plot}

p1 <- make_priority_plot(1)
p2 <- make_priority_plot(2)
p3 <- make_priority_plot(3)
p4 <- make_priority_plot(4)
p5 <- make_priority_plot(5)

p1 <- p1 +
  labs(y = "Health Topic") +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    )
  )

chna_final_plot <- (p1 | p2) /
              (p3 | p4) /
              (p5 | plot_spacer()) +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distribution of CHNA Health Priorities Across Illinois Counties",
    caption = "Number of Counties",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 15,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 12,
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(t = 10)
      )
    )
  )

chna_final_plot

```

## Save

```{r, save}

ggsave(
  filename = "graph/idpha_chna.png",
  plot = chna_final_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)


```
